status: read-only source applicability review; PSE-03 nine inland-water cells remain held; no geometry or qualification execution

new_primary_read.read_method: programmatic PDF open/text extraction; no browser
new_primary_read.result: World Bank Document, Jordan Poverty Update, Volume I: Main Report, November 2009; 39 PDF pages. PDF page 39 (web extraction page P38) contains a Jordan map labeled GOVERNORATE BOUNDARIES, names BALQA, includes 35–39E/29–34N graticule and scale, and is marked IBRD 33424 / JANUARY 2005. Its imprint states it was produced by the World Bank Map Design Unit and says displayed boundaries do not imply a World Bank judgment on legal status or endorsement/acceptance. The report itself describes the joint DOS/World Bank poverty analysis, not the provenance of the consumed 2006 Balqa feature geometry.
new_primary_read.relevant_pdf_page_lines: https://dosweb.dos.gov.jo/DataBank/Analytical_Reports/Poverty/poverty_rep/Jordan_Poverty_report_2006_part1.pdf (PDF page 39; extracted lines include BALQA, 35–39E/29–34N, January 2005, IBRD 33424, Map Design Unit disclaimer)
new_primary_read.scope_limit: The map is broad dated cartographic context and identifies Balqa, but supplies no machine-readable Balqa feature, exact 2006 source lineage, local nine-key relation, or evidentiary basis for equating its generalized boundary with the consumed geoBoundaries/Wikimedia polygon. It is not an official DOS boundary-data record merely because DOS hosts the report. No geometry was derived from it.

assessment.parent_crosswalk_limit: The PSE ADM1/ADM2 hierarchy supports same-source parent-role treatment for West Bank versus its PSE ADM2 children. Balqa is a separate Jordan ADM1 family, separately recorded as a territorial exclusion. The PSE parent relationship cannot explain or dispose of the Balqa contact.
assessment.finding: The accessible DOS-hosted map confirms that a Balqa governorate boundary was depicted in a January 2005 World Bank map and locates the named governorate in regional context. It does not independently authenticate the 2006 Balqa polygon lineage or resolve the exact PSE-03 contact. Balqa remains a live competing source contact under the original contract.
assessment.disposition: No change: preserve all nine PSE-03 native holds and the original PSE denominator. This bounded read adds contextual evidence, not a sovereignty conclusion, exclusion veto, or qualification result.
assessment.next_material_witness: A source-specific link from the retained 2006 geoBoundaries/Wikimedia Balqa feature to an attributable Jordanian administrative boundary source/version, or an exact accessible Jordan primary spatial record that documents the feature lineage. No denial was encountered in the PDF read; this report does not claim exhaustive absence of other records.
